summary: Iteration 48 — Regression pass after routes refactor (2,687 lines moved from server.py into 5 new modules: routes/ads.py, routes/rewards.py, routes/kredo.py, routes/cover.py, routes/auth.py). Backend contract is 100% preserved. Pytest suite of 25 cases: 24 passed, 1 skipped (FB-000083 no longer exists in preview DB — earliest present is FB-000002 / FB-000104; not a code issue). Verified end-to-end from the UI: dealer Dave (dave@fourbuy.co.za / Dave1234!) logs in, home renders correctly with the 'Welcome back, David' hero, Give Cover NavFlipTile shows badge '1' and hint '1 car waiting · R10 each' (matches backend /api/cover/submissions filter !my_cover). Tapping Give Cover navigates to /cover which shows the three tabs (Available · 1 / Cover given · 5 / Declined · 0), the R10 explainer card, and the FB-000002 Toyota Hilux row with a red decline circle. Tapping the Rewards tile loads the Fourbuy Rewards screen showing balance 17 pts, '33 more points until your next voucher', Earned/Spent/Refunded chips, and the per-submission points-activity ledger. No red screens, zero JS console errors. AUTH: dealer + admin login OK, wrong-password → 401 with error detail, /auth/me returns {user:{...}} including referral_code + dealership enrichment, forgot-password returns 200 for both known and unknown emails (no account-existence leak), reset-password with bogus token → 400. ADS: /api/admin/ads returns {slots:[...]} with all 10 slots (slot 1 = Ford Bryanston with base64 image), /api/ads/active returns {ads:[...]} for the dealer rotating banner. REWARDS: /api/rewards/me + admin listings + leaderboard endpoints all 200. KREDO: /api/kredo/value with the correct payload shape (make, model, year:str, derivative, mileage, condition) returns 200 (the cross-module `_ensure_market_values` re-import at server.py:6595 works — highest-risk dependency), /api/kredo/makes 200 authed / 401 unauthed, /api/kredo/cartrust/status/{unknown} → 404. COVER: /api/cover/submissions 200 for pricing agent Dave (6 rows), /api/cover/declined-submissions 200, 401 unauthed, 403 for admin. REFERRAL: /api/referral/lookup?code=<Dave's code> returns his name + dealership; unknown code → 404. Refactor is safe to merge. Data-drift note: FB-000083 (previously cartrust=pending) is no longer in the preview DB, so that specific CarTrust status check was skipped — endpoint contract remains verified via the unknown-id 404 path.
